name: reverse-skill
description: Reverse Engineering / Authorized Penetration Testing / Security Research Skill Router Pack AI-powered routing + On-demand toolchain bootstrapping + Self-evolving knowledge base Supports Claude Code, Kiro, Cursor, Cline, and other AI coding clients 逆向/渗透/安全技能路由包 - AI 自动路由 + 按需自举工具链 + 自动进化经验库 | 支持 Claude Code / Kiro / Cursor / Cline 等代码 AI 客户端
one_liner: A toolkit that plugs specialized reverse-engineering and authorized-penetration-testing knowledge into AI coding assistants, so the AI can act like a security researcher on demand.
buyer: A boutique penetration-testing firm or independent security researcher who wants their AI coding assistant to handle routine reverse-engineering grunt work under their supervision.
business_use_cases: A penetration-testing firm uses it to speed up authorized engagement work, billing clients for outcomes rather than hours saved.
A security researcher builds a paid AI-assisted CTF training tool for students using its skill-routing approach.
A red-team consultancy productizes a hardened, supported fork of it as a premium tool for enterprise security teams.

money_ideas.idea: Paid, supported enterprise fork with vetted skill packs and liability guardrails.
Training workshops teaching security teams to use AI-assisted reverse engineering responsibly.

steal_this: This is a narrow, credential-gated niche tool — worth watching, not worth a quick weekend clone unless you already run a security practice with the authorization to use it.
